executable_rebind_APIs.averaging: The matrix contraction already includes 1/4. Pass initial_state_average=1 when its result is consumed, or supply an unaveraged spin sum with initial_state_average=4, never both.
executable_rebind_APIs.beam: validate_beam_mode_embedding(G,W,Q,metadata): actual positive Dirac Cauchy pairing, four packet-spin modes, charge operator and explicit new benchmark/background/positive-frequency/family/wavepacket provenance.
executable_rebind_APIs.collision_readout: Existing two_to_two_differential_cross_section/integrate_two_to_two_cross_section consume physical same-unit masses and action amplitude; they do not generate the amplitude or prepared Cauchy state.
executable_rebind_APIs.spin_amplitude: spin_averaged_amplitude_squared(M4x4)=Tr(M*(I4/4)*M^dagger). A physical action-derived amplitude is required; none defaulted.

independent_remaining_inputs: New benchmark regular-stratum collision background/geometry, active domains, action Cauchy pairing and tetrad/momentum map, with coupled constraints and asymptotic/finite-boundary preparation specified.

Electron and positron packet mode functions: spatial/energy spread, separation and encounter timing/overlap, longitudinal profile and phase/coherence data where observable; b=0 and equal central energies do not determine these functions.

Physical positive-frequency/antiparticle embedding and background matter covariance, with Hadamard/renormalization prescription only for state-sensitive contractions that use them; exact pair excitations are not inferred from free retarded propagation.
The native same-domain electron/muon manifestation/pole states, masses and residues in a common action unit. Frozen family labels alone are not those pole modes.
Same-action interacting gauge/Higgs/gravity/matter scattering amplitude or causal encounter solution and final muon pair/outgoing readout; universal phase-space helpers need these operands.
A numerical beam-energy scan range/grid once an owned energy unit and accessible threshold are bound; no phenomenological theory coefficient is fitted.

outgoing_readout.final_zoo: All other admitted action-coupled fields, particles, radiation and surviving enclosure/geometry degrees remain in the outgoing realization.
outgoing_readout.target: The muon-antimuon family component is an OUTPUT projection/readout of the action-derived outgoing state.
outgoing_readout.two_body_kinematic_scope: The displayed opposite outgoing momenta and two-body phase-space helper describe the exclusive two-body muon-pair component when that readout applies; they are not a projection deleting real radiation or other output channels.

pair_state_scope.CAR_convention: N_ij=<c_j^dagger c_i>; C_sd=diag(I-N,N^T); canonical antiunitary Gamma(v)=G*conjugate(v).
pair_state_scope.exact_preparation: rho_pair=1/4 sum_(s,t) |e-_s,e+_t><e-_s,e+_t| on exactly-one-of-each charge sector.
pair_state_scope.family_antiparticle_owner: Q_family=diag(P_family,conjugate(P_family)) from the existing constructor. Full spin/carrier charge-conjugation intertwiners still belong to the supplied physical packet embedding.
pair_state_scope.one_body_covariance_not_whole_state: N=I4/2 and C_sd=I8/2 have the same two-point data as a quasifree half-occupation state, but the exact pair has <n_eup*n_edown>=0 rather than 1/4. Preserve rho_pair for four-point collision contractions.

physical_preparation.channel_authority: User selected electron-positron collider production of a muon-antimuon pair as the first predictive benchmark.
physical_preparation.energy: External beam-energy scan variable E_beam; no numerical energy or energy grid selected.
physical_preparation.geometry_of_beam_centers: Equal-energy head-on incoming beams; zero transverse impact parameter for the first baseline.
physical_preparation.polarization: Unpolarized baseline assumption, explicitly replaceable: independent I_spin2/2 for each incoming species.

selected_family_map.mapping_source: Frozen MODE_ASSIGNMENTS/ROLE_ORDER and rank-one slot_projectors, cross-checked against preserved family-fiber rows. No mass screen reordered the slots.

symbolic_head_on_kinematics.dimensionless_axis: x=E_beam/m_mu_action is only a symbolic dimensionless control when the native muon pole is bound. No QED reference curve or empirical mass fixes the BHSM action, scale or packet.
symbolic_head_on_kinematics.frame: Local orthonormal collider tetrad with +--- convention; no global flat geometry inferred.
symbolic_head_on_kinematics.tetrad_to_coordinate_momentum: Requires a new benchmark background/tetrad and ActionMomentumMap from that action geometry; no old C2 geometry or unowned Minkowski physical map is inserted.
symbolic_head_on_kinematics.threshold: E_beam>=max(m_e_action,m_mu_action) for the displayed two-body channel once physical same-action pole masses and common units are supplied.
